$comment: Loadout share codes made by each implementation (`void_loadout::share` in Rust, `ShareCode` in the Java mod, `share-code.ts` in @void/protocol). Every implementation's test suite decodes every code here and checks it against `expect`, so the three readers and three writers cannot drift apart without a test failing. `expect.mods` lists the settings that must come out (a subset of the effective settings), `hud_items` how many HUD items survive. Regenerate a code deliberately when its writer's payload changes; each writer has a test that pins its own entry.
